rules_fired: Any subdimension Min Level 3 → recommend Level 3.7
rationale: Marcus Reyes presents with a moderate alcohol withdrawal syndrome (CIWA-Ar = 12 on admission) compounded by concurrent benzodiazepine use disorder, requiring medically managed withdrawal monitoring and an active chlordiazepoxide taper. The deterministic rule engine resolves these findings to Level 3.7 (Medically Monitored Intensive Inpatient) per Chapter 10 rules. Co-occurring depressive and anxious symptoms (PHQ-9 = 18, GAD-7 = 15) with passive ideation only are appropriate for a standard co-occurring-capable program, so the recommendation is non-COE and non-BIO.
